checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CRAFT-ATTACK: Ensure IO-heavy transactions are metered with correct fork-specific gas schedule
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the gas metering code path invoked when transactions enter via the transaction pool. 2. Verify that block number is checked against the Tangerine Whistle fork threshold (2,463,000) before selecting gas costs. 3. Confirm that IO-heavy opcodes (SLOAD, BALANCE, EXTCODESIZE, CALL, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, SUICIDE) use repriced gas values for post-fork blocks. 4. Test with a crafted transaction containing maximum IO operations at the fork boundary block to ensure correct gas accounting. 5. Verify no path exists where pre-fork gas costs are applied to post-fork blocks.
executable_checks: Submit a transaction with 100+ SLOAD operations at block 2,463,000 and verify total gas consumed matches EIP-150 costs
Submit identical transaction at block 2,462,999 and verify pre-fork gas costs are applied
Attempt to exhaust node resources with IO-heavy transactions at post-fork blocks and confirm gas limit prevents DoS
checklist.notes: Boundary property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP608-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-CRAFT-ATTACK from EXT-DOS-ATTACKER-TX to Execution Layer (EL) via Transaction pool / EVM gas metering. Security assumption: EIP-150 gas repricing must be applied for all IO-heavy operations at post-Tangerine Whistle blocks. Archetypal vectors include malicious users submitting resource exhaustion attacks via JSON-RPC.

checklist.title: Verify attack state is correctly identified when pre-fork gas costs would enable DoS
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the state machine logic that determines whether an attack is possible based on gas metering. 2. Verify that the STATE-ATTACK-POSSIBLE state is only reachable when gas costs are insufficient to prevent resource exhaustion. 3. Confirm that post-EIP-150 gas repricing eliminates the attack state for IO-heavy operations.
executable_checks: Trace execution of IO-heavy transaction at pre-fork block and confirm attack state is flagged
Trace same transaction at post-fork block and confirm attack state is not reachable
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-EIP608-PRECOND-002. Validates internal logic supporting EDGE-CRAFT-ATTACK boundary security.

checklist.title: Verify crafted transaction processing enforces gas schedule at entry point
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the transaction crafting/submission handler. 2. Verify that gas estimation and validation occur before transaction execution begins. 3. Confirm that the gas schedule selection is based on the target block number, not the submission time.
executable_checks: Submit a transaction targeting a specific block and verify gas schedule matches that block's fork rules
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-EIP608-PRECOND-002. Node ACTION-ATTACKER-CRAFT-TX represents the entry action at the trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BEACON-NODE-REQUEST: Block signing requests validated against slashing protection DB
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the validator client's block signing request handler at the beacon node API interface. 2. Verify that every signing request triggers a lookup in the slashing protection database before any signing key is used. 3. Confirm that the block slot is compared against the minimum previously signed slot. 4. Test with a signing request for a slot lower than the recorded minimum and verify rejection. 5. Test with a duplicate signing request for the same slot with a different signing root and verify rejection. 6. Verify that missing signing roots are treated conservatively as conflicts.
executable_checks: Send block signing request for slot N, then send another for slot N-1 and verify rejection
Send block signing request for slot N with root R1, then for slot N with root R2 and verify rejection
Send block signing request with empty signing root for a previously signed slot and verify conservative rejection
checklist.notes: Boundary property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP3076-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-BEACON-NODE-REQUEST from EXT-BEACON-NODE to Consensus Layer (CL) via Validator client block/attestation signing API. Security assumption: all signing requests must be checked against slashing protection DB regardless of authenticated channel.

checklist.title: Verify block signing request state captures all required fields for slashing check
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the block signing request data structure. 2. Verify it contains slot number, signing root, and validator public key. 3. Confirm that missing fields cause request rejection rather than default values.
executable_checks: Send signing request missing slot field and verify rejection
Send signing request missing signing root and verify conservative handling
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-EIP3076-PRECOND-001. Node STATE-BLOCK-SIGN-REQUEST is the entry state at the trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify slashing rule check action correctly queries and compares DB records
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the slashing rule check implementation. 2. Verify the DB query retrieves all previously signed blocks for the validator. 3. Confirm the comparison uses >= for slot minimum check. 4. Verify signing root comparison handles null/missing roots conservatively.
executable_checks: Populate DB with signed block at slot 100, attempt signing at slot 100 with same root (should pass)
Attempt signing at slot 100 with different root (should fail)
Attempt signing at slot 99 (should fail)
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-EIP3076-PRECOND-001. ACTION-CHECK-BLOCK-SLASHING-RULES implements the core security logic behind the boundary.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create an interchange file with invalid JSON schema (wrong version, missing fields, wrong types). 2. Attempt import. 3. Verify rejection and transition to STATE-FILE-SCHEMA-INVALID. 4. Verify no partial import occurs. 5. Test with schema version mismatch.
executable_checks: Import interchange file with missing 'metadata' field and verify rejection
Import file with wrong interchange_format_version and verify rejection
Import file with invalid signing_root format and verify rejection
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP3076-POSTCOND-006. Primary element: STATE-FILE-SCHEMA-INVALID. Falsification target: verify invalid schema files are rejected completely.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: Verify block signing approval only after all checks pass
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the complete block signing approval path. 2. Verify all checks (slot floor, duplicate detection, signing root comparison) execute before approval. 3. Verify no short-circuit path bypasses any check. 4. Test with a request that passes some checks but fails one, and verify no signing occurs.
executable_checks: Submit request passing slot check but failing root check, verify no signing
Verify all check functions are called in the approval path
Verify signing key is only accessed after STATE-BLOCK-SIGNING-APPROVED
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP3076-POSTCOND-010. Primary element: STATE-BLOCK-SIGNING-APPROVED. Falsification target: reach approval state without completing all checks.

checklist.title: Falsify invariant: Cause data loss or corruption during duplicate public key merge
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create two interchange files with overlapping validator public keys but different signing histories. 2. Import both files. 3. Verify the merged record contains the union of all signed blocks and attestations. 4. Verify no records are lost during merge. 5. Test with conflicting records for the same slot/epoch.
executable_checks: Import file A with validator V having blocks at slots [1,2,3], import file B with V at slots [3,4,5], verify merged = [1,2,3,4,5]
Merge files with different signing roots for same slot and verify conservative handling
Verify merge is idempotent (importing same file twice produces same result)
checklist.notes: Internal invariant property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP3076-INV-005. Primary element: ACTION-MERGE-VALIDATOR-RECORDS. Falsification target: cause data loss during duplicate key merge.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: Verify promise resolves with correct RPC result on success
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call provider.request() with a known RPC method (e.g., eth_blockNumber). 2. Verify the promise resolves (not rejects). 3. Verify the resolved value matches the expected RPC response format. 4. Verify no extra fields or wrapping is added to the result. 5. Test with various RPC methods to ensure consistent behavior.
executable_checks: Call eth_blockNumber and verify promise resolves with hex string
Call eth_chainId and verify promise resolves with correct chain ID
Verify resolved value is the raw result, not wrapped in an envelope
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP1193-POSTCOND-001. Primary element: STATE-REQUEST-RESOLVED. Falsification target: verify promise resolution side effect is correct.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: Verify 'connect' event emission with chainId after connection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Register a listener for the 'connect' event. 2. Establish a provider connection. 3. Verify the event fires exactly once. 4. Verify the event data includes chainId as a hex string. 5. Verify the chainId matches the connected chain. 6. Test that reconnection emits a new 'connect' event.
executable_checks: Listen for 'connect' event, establish connection, verify event fires with chainId
Verify chainId in event matches eth_chainId result
Verify event fires exactly once per connection
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP1193-POSTCOND-005. Primary element: ACTION-EMIT-CONNECT. Falsification target: verify connect event is emitted as required side effect.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: Verify account revocation removes all access
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Grant account access to a DApp. 2. Verify eth_accounts returns the accounts. 3. Revoke account access. 4. Call eth_accounts and verify empty array is returned. 5. Verify 'accountsChanged' event is emitted with empty array. 6. Attempt to use a previously authorized account for signing and verify rejection.
executable_checks: Grant access, revoke, call eth_accounts, verify empty result
Verify 'accountsChanged' event fires with [] after revocation
Attempt eth_sign after revocation and verify 4100 error
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP1193-POSTCOND-009. Primary element: ACTION-USER-REVOKES-ACCOUNTS. Falsification target: verify revocation fully removes account exposure.

checklist.title: Falsify invariant: Cause non-standard error codes to be returned
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger each error condition: user rejection (4001), unauthorized (4100), unsupported method (4200), disconnected (4900), chain disconnected (4901). 2. Verify each returns the exact standardized error code. 3. Verify error message is a string. 4. Verify error data field is optional and structured. 5. Test that internal errors do not leak non-standard codes.
executable_checks: Reject a request in consent dialog and verify error code is 4001
Call unauthorized method and verify error code is 4100
Call unsupported method and verify error code is 4200
checklist.notes: Internal invariant property. Source: PROP-W0-EIP1193-INV-004. Primary element: ACTION-DETERMINE-ERROR-CODE. Falsification target: cause wrong or non-standard error codes to be returned.
